context: A boss reviews corp safety policy
purpose: Teach: 除け/処方/知見/養う/備える/凶/調書/力強く

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: リスク除けの体制、各部署で、整えろ。
lines.en: Make sure each department has a risk-management system in place.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Each clause lands with quiet authority. No inflection needed — the weight is in the competence. Short pauses between instructions, like checking them off.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のメンタル、処方として、休暇制度、強化しました。
lines.en: Yes. We've strengthened the leave system as part of supporting our staff's mental health.
lines.style: Clear, methodical. Speaking from preparation — the words are already thought through. Respectful register without obsequiousness. Slight emphasis on 'strengthened' to show the work is done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界知見、社員教育に、活用しろ。
lines.en: Use what you know from the industry to train the staff better.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. A light emphasis on 'use' — there's implicit expectation here. Calm authority. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社が社員を養う責任、創業以来、変わりません。
lines.en: Yes. We've held to that responsibility since we started — the company's obligation to support its people hasn't changed.
lines.style: Sincere undertone. Kenji is anchoring something here, almost like a principle. Slower than before. Conviction that doesn't need to prove itself. Slight softening on the final clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 災害に備える備蓄、各事業所で、確保しろ。
lines.en: Secure emergency supplies at each of our locations.
lines.style: Same level of direct authority as before. Clear, executable. No qualification. The tone sits somewhere between instruction and trust that it will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。凶悪事件への警戒、社内、徹底しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining strict internal protocols for any serious incidents.
lines.style: Reassuring without sounding uncertain. Steady pacing. The 'strict' is not defensive — it's factual. Professional confidence that this is already in hand.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: コンプラ違反の調書、対応、慎重にしろ。
lines.en: Handle any compliance violations carefully. Don't rush the investigation.
lines.style: Measured caution here. Not alarming, but firm. The emphasis lands on 'carefully' — there's weight to that word. A slight slowdown at the end, like a warning delivered quietly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、力強く、社業を支えてくれています。
lines.en: Yes. Our people are the real strength behind everything we do.
lines.style: Quieter, more personal than before — this is the real statement he's been building toward. Sincere, not performative. A small exhale after 'strength,' like something genuine just came through.
